# temps_email_domain (Resource)

A sending domain of a `temps_email_provider`. Publish `dns_records` in the zone, then Temps verifies it; authorize projects to send from it with `temps_email_domain_project`.

Import with `<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `email_domains:read`, `email_domains:create`, `email_domains:delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_email_domain" "mail" {
  provider_id = temps_email_provider.smtp.id
  domain      = "mail.example.com"
}

# Publish these records in the zone so Temps can verify the domain.
output "mail_dns_records" {
  value = jsondecode(temps_email_domain.mail.dns_records)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain to send from.
- `provider_id` (Number) ID of the email provider.

### Read-Only

- `dns_records` (String) Records to publish, as JSON (`jsondecode(...)`): type, name and value of each.
- `id` (String) Import ID, `<id>`.
- `status` (String) Verification status.
- `verification_error` (String) Why verification failed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <id>
terraform import temps_email_domain.mail 3
```
